scene: The brass key hums softly, unlocking rooftop exits to the city.
picture: Flat side view along the tiled museum rooftop. On the far left, a sleek yellow shuttle van idles with its door open. Centre left, the boy stands holding his skateboard and glowing key. In the centre, a red double-decker bus waits at a curb. On the far right, a wooden rope-bridge lift sways beside tall cables.
